U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

The Solicitor General

Washington, D.C. 20530 

April 4,2018 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:

Kirstjen M. Nielsen, Secretary of Homeland Security, et al., v. Mony 
Preap, et al., No. 16-1363 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on March 19, 
2018. Petitioners' brief on the merits is currently due May 3, 2018, and argument would not be 
before October 2018. 

Because of scheduling difficulties and the press of other matters before the Court, the 
parties respectfully request, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, that it adopt the following 
schedule for the merits briefing: 

Brief for petitioners:
Brief for respondents:
Reply brief:

June 1, 2018 
August 6, 2018 
September 10, 2018 

Counsel for petitioners and both sets of respondents have agreed on the schedule above. 

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
